notes.title: PATCH BRIEFING 04.12.2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/6f7c2a4cb572d81c360167e5ec2113e258f6cec3.png[/img][h1][b]PATCH BRIEFING
[/b][/h1]
Hello, Rangers!

GM-vChaos here reporting in our patch briefing.

For this patch, we are trying out new ways of approach based on popular demand along with new weapons into our arsenal.

Let's take a look of the changes we are about to make.

[h2][b]BALANCE[/b][/h2]
Weapon Rebalance is one of the interesting topics that has been the word of mouth for a long time.
Our developers tread in this path very carefully and always looking for ways to give Rangers a fair fight against each other.

Based on the data, game experience and feedback, we have chosen one particular SMG
that has been bringing Rangers at the top of the battlefield. Stay tuned for more.

[h2][b]MAP UPDATES
[/b][/h2]I'm compiling an update for Terror Dome. I received a lot of feedback from competitive players, 
so I made some changes to make the map more balanced for both teams.

Terrordome Patch Notes:
- Fixed exploits that allowed players to leave the map
- Removed B-site alarms from Search & Destroy mode
- Various changes to improve map balance 
- Lowered ambient sound volume
- Improved lighting in Quarantine mode

We have also opened Game Modes for players to enjoy.
Arms Race
Capture the Flag
Last man standing
Quarantine Regen(HOT)
Spy Hunt
VIP Elimination

[h2][b]FIXES
[/b][/h2]Part of our patch briefing tackles some fixes that were reported by users.

> Fixed Wheel of Fate inventory that did not update last patch.
In my defense, GMChaos was hungry at the time and we're giving him more cheese.

> Fixed an issue where purchasing DarkHorizon's Package and Uruchi's Alternative Package causes an error to show.

We are hoping that these features are enjoyed by our players and as always,
if you have any ideas, GMvChaos is ready to jot them down for you.

For the community,
GM-vChaos


To get the latest news and happenings, please join or follow our official sites:

▶Discord: https://discord.gg/combatarms

▶VFUN Lounge: https://vfun-lounge.valofe.com/page/ca_classic/all

▶Facebook : https://www.facebook.com/combatarmstheclassic.vfun

notes.title: Isabella the Love Torn
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/55e7821da85fb74d164b525642fbba1ab817685f.jpg[/img]
Meet Isabella: once a cold Assassin, now transformed into an Artist. Betrayed by her love, Alessio, on Valentine's Day, her art reflects the twisted aftermath of heartbreak. Channeling her anguish into refined skills of killing, she hunts those who break hearts every Valentine's Day. Through the weapons she crafts, Isabella finds catharsis, turning her pain into a poignant tribute to the complex dance of love and loss.

[h2][b]Isabella The Love Torn[/b][/h2]
[b][i]Isabella[/i][/b], a once-cold Assassin turned into Artist, suffered a heartbreaking betrayal by her love, Alessio, on Valentine's Day. The discovery left her art transformed, warping her compassion into loathing. Now, she now refines her skills of killing and turning it into art. Now, every Valentine's Day, she hunts those who break hearts in every corner. Yet, through the weapons she crafted, Isabella finds a cathartic release, turning her heartbreak into a poignant testament to the bittersweet symphony of love and loss.

notes.title: Hell Knight Gear
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/80276516166bcabe0a16d1f065ee818afc5e56fc.jpg[/img]

Introducing the Hell Knight!
The Equipment of the Underworld.

[h2][b] [i] Hell Knight Gears [/i] [/b] [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/72ac19e6e75c0de161ca33810292a15659085501.png[/img]

[h3][b][i]Hell Knight Vest[/i][/b][/h3]
This charred leather jacket, adorned with flickering flames, offers both protection and an intimidating aura. Its fireskin wards off the chill of the underworld while embodying the resilience of a Hell Knight.

[table]
    [tr]
        [td]Protection[/td]
        [td]40%[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Speed[/td]
        [td]17%[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Sprint Stamina[/td]
        [td]18%[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/5e39e48e97751001a85959600f1ae9c3923da9d1.png[/img]
[h3][b][i]Hell Knight Robot Skull Helmet[/i][/b][/h3]
A menacing visage, this robot skull helm wreathed in unending flames strikes fear into the hearts of foes. Its blazing gaze serves as a testament to the fiery determination of a true Hell Knight.

[table]
    [tr]
        [td]Protects from Gas[/td]
        [td]30%[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Protects from Flash[/td]
        [td]50%[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Headshot Protection[/td]
        [td]50%[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Speed[/td]
        [td]15%[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Sprint Stamina[/td]
        [td]15%[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

[h2][i][b]New Gear[/b][/i][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/3b14af52f8fe2ee551ee0e6bf790d9befc3196f9.png[/img]
[h3][b][i]Zeus Thunderbeard[/i][/b][/h3]
The NMX corporation's remarkable invention, Thunderbeard, is a formidable face armor meticulously reconstructed from Zeus' majestic beard. Exclusively designed for exceptional soldiers capable of tapping into Zeus' essence, Thunderbeard grants its wearers enhanced resilience and symbolizing the fusion of mortal strength with the might of the gods.

[h3][b][i]Mantle of Zeus[/i][/b][/h3]
The NMX corporation's reimagined vest, crafted from the rewoven mantle of Zeus, is a remarkable fusion of divine fabric and advanced technology. Reserved for the most exceptional soldiers capable of channeling Zeus' essence, this vest empowers its wearers with electrifying energy, granting them heightened strength, agility, and the ability to command thunder and lightning on the battlefield.

[h3][b][i]Zeus Stormbringer[/i][/b][/h3]
The NMX corporation's ingenious creation, known as Stormbringer, is a formidable bag reconstructed from Zeus' thunderbolt. Reserved exclusively for elite soldiers with the ability to harness Zeus' essence, this extraordinary bag serves as a portable arsenal and empowering the chosen warriors to wield the fury of the gods in their missions.

[h2][b]New Item[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]MYST - Greek God Ultimate Box II (x1,x7 & x15)(x1,x7 & x15)[/b][/h3]
Introducing the "Greek God Ultimate Box I" available in the item shop of your favorite FPS game! Unleash the power of the gods with this exclusive box filled with mighty Greek God Zeus Weapons alongside a collection of Ultra Rare weapons and items, granting you the divine arsenal needed to dominate the battlefield like never before.

[h3][b]MYST - Sands of Annihilation Standard/Hardcore/Ruthless(reward on double boss stage)[/b][/h3]
The Sands of Annihilation Reward Chest, a coveted prize obtained exclusively by conquering the treacherous Boss Battle, holds the promise of untold riches. Within its mysterious depths lie an assortment of tantalizing surprises, from powerful weapons and experience passes to combat dice and vibrant spray paints, ensuring that each opening is an exhilarating gamble with potentially game-changing rewards.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/8fe90164af3a7c25003f8b6ac6b6801688ee0de8.png[/img]
[h3][b]Bio-Blaster MK.48[/b][/h3]
The "Bio-Blaster" is a formidable upgrade of the MK.48 Beetle Machine Gun, meticulously crafted using advanced components harvested from an otherworldly creature and a mechanized robot discovered amidst the "Sands of Annihilation." This cutting-edge weapon seamlessly merges alien biotechnology with robotic precision, unleashing a devastating fusion of organic and mechanical firepower upon its targets.

notes.title: Embrace the Might of Zeus - Zeus Weapons
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/d15c49185fe5cfaf164436a0e62ceb5c9e53e004.jpg[/img]
The First Generation of Greek God Weapons, crafted by NMX, harnesses the extraordinary power of Zeus. The XM8, infused with the essence of Zeus' crystalline bolt, amplifies its fire rate and power, bestowing those chosen to wield it with the blessings of the Gods. Similarly, the PP-19 contains a fragment of Zeus' crystalline bolt, granting it exceptional close combat prowess and the ability to eliminate enemies with ease through its burst shots. As for the Kukri, forged with the tip of Zeus' Crystal, it possesses unparalleled sharpness and cutting power, enabling its wielder to effortlessly vanquish any foe while experiencing the might of Zeus with each slash.

Below is the full details of the weapons:

[h2][i][b]New Weapon[/b][/i][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/1087b4d09666eafebe95ed837eb0f1416baa577d.png[/img]
[h3][b][i]Zeus XM8 [/i][/b][/h3]
First Generation of Greek God Weapons designed by NMX. This XM8 was designed to sustain the essence of Zeus' crystalline bolt to upgrade its fire rate and power. Those who are chosen to weild such weapons is said to be blessed by the Gods.

First Generation of Greek God Weapons designed by NMX. This PP-19 was designed to contain a fragment of Zeus' crystalline bolt to enhance its close combat prowess and provide burst shots that can easily eliminate enemies. It is said that the wielder is able to win any mission without fail.

notes.title: Desert Deathmatch & Outpost 31 (Quarantine Regen)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/2481b9f9f6fdacfdf8316a0c9a5580a4fb148891.jpg[/img]
[u][b][h2]Desert Deathmatch[/h2][/b][/u]
We have added a new Boss battle for you to conquer. This will be a team battle with two phases, you heard it right two bosses will be encountered on this new map.

We introduce to you the Beetle and the Scorpion. Both monsters have unique skills that will test your survival skills. 

1st boss - The Beetle

This boss is protected by a thick layer of armor, discovering the weak spot is a must! It has a set of skills that will use a defensive stance, dash, and cocoon skills separately.
[list]
[*] Dash: The beetle rushes through a straight line quickly, dealing damage to enemies in its path.
[*] Cocoon: The beetle spits out a cloud of slime (which cannot be avoided) to trap a player in. If the cocoon is not destroyed after a while, it will hatch many mobs.
[*] Defensive stance: The beetle raises its forelimbs for defense, which will also summon many mobs, and the beetle's weaknesses will be exposed.
[/list]
Also, be aware that if you are on the striking range the Beetle will attack by swinging its forelimbs at you!

2nd boss - The Scorpion

After you have defeated the defensive Beetle, the deadly Scorpion will be coming above ground. He has deathly skills that could wipe your team from battle. You need to be aware of his skills Ground Crash, Venom Barrage, and Ground Sting skills.

[list]
[*] Ground Crash: The scorpion raises its forelimb and smashes them on the ground, dealing damage to enemies directly in front of it.
[*] Venom Barrage: The scorpion uses its tail to quickly spray a circle of bullets. Players need to dodge or they need to bear damage if got hit.
[*]  Ground Sting: The scorpion buries its tail stinger in the ground and spines it out quickly after a certain time, causing damage to nearby players.
[/list]
Be aware that these bosses are not alone as they are accompanied by small beetles and mosquitoes that will come and attack you also. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/2885b16ca0ff19c3474554bfd4420b344a51c007.jpg[/img]

We have discovered a new outbreak! The newest map added to the Quarantine Regen is Outpost 31. 

Players will try to survive by killing or avoiding being infected within the time limit. Be careful as going outside the research facility will give out frostbite damage. 

Plan it out with your comrades as you try to kill or survive the infected going at you.

NEW FUNCTION

Room Rank Restriction

1. When the players create a room, they can give the room a certain rank limit (which did not exist until the update). There are currently two new restrictions:
1-30 (Rookie Zone)
31-60 (Veteran Zone)

2. There are some conditions to create restricted-rank rooms
The players whose rank under 30 can only create Rookie Zone and non-restricted Zone.
The players whose rank from 31-49 can only create non-restricted Zone.
The players whose rank over 50 can only create Veteran Zone and non-restricted Zone.

3. When a player creates a room, he or she can choose the corresponding rank limit or not. Once created, players can also change the settings for rank limits. 4. Rooms that have created restrictions have an explicit icon in the list of rooms in the lobby, and no-icon indicate no-restrictions.

5. No password can be set for Rookie/Veteran restricted rooms.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/e2b2bded0713118773e028b8a273be7bbb594229.jpg[/img]


Attention Rangers!
Let’s rise up to occasion and join our brothers in arms as we introduce support for the Arabic Language. Combat Arms: the Classic is now available in the Arabic Language. It’s now more convenient for our Arabic-speaking brethren to head on to the battles and challenges Combat Arms: the Classic has in store. Let us make it extra special with our treat of goodies for our Arabic Users.
Head on over to our website for more details.
That’s all Rangers! Happy Hunting. Out!
Eligibility: Newly registered ARABIC User Accounts
Requirement: Coupon Codes from ARABIC YouTube Streamers
Duration: July 14, 2020 – August 31, 2020 (Subject to change)

Event Details
EXCLUSIVE COUPON CODE!
Over US$100 worth of Special Items and Packages just for Arabic Users!

※ How to claim Event Coupon?
The coupon system is now live and can now be used by Arabic Users.
Here are very important details you need to remember.

Supplies are limited so be sure to grab them as soon as you can!

* Event Period: July 14th – August 31st ​
* How to participate: Arabic Users should tune in to Combat Arms: Classic YouTube streamers as they give out the Event coupon codes.
* Reward: Over US$100 worth of Exclusive Items & Packages.
*How to redeem my rewards: Login to Combat Arms: Classic and head-on over to the "ENTER CODE" tab then enter your coupon code.

※ IMPORTANT NOTICE
1. Coupon Codes can be claimed ONCE per account.
2. A total of 21 items are included inside the Coupon code upon claiming.
3. Redemption of the Coupon Code can only be completed in-game through the Combat Arms: Classic "ENTER CODE" tab.
4. Only Arabic Users are eligible to participate in the Coupon Code event. ​
5. Coupon codes can be redeemed in-game up until the 31st of August 2020. (Duration is subject to change). ​


Event Rewards:
1* Wraith Package
1* Red Sickle (Melee)
1* Desert Eagle (Pistol)
1* World Cup Arabia (Shirt)
1* Mythic Weapon Renewal Kit

================================================================================

Event #1: SPECIAL RECRUITMENT GIVEAWAY


Want more non-stop action that’ll keep you at the edge of your seat? Is sparkly gunplay too fancy?
Then we got you covered with the right mix of hardcore fps action and a variety of game modes that will keep your heart pound ‘in at every step of the way!
REGISTER to Combat Arms: the Classic now! and be better equipped to take on missions and challenges! Get the game and grab your Newbie Package just by logging in.
That’s all Rangers! Happy Hunting. Out!
Eligibility: Newly Registered Accounts ONLY
Requirements: New Character creation
Duration: July 14, 2020 - August 31, 2020

Reward Details:
Ten-Hut! For the new blood to Combat Arms: the Classic.
We've got your bag fully-loaded with the best and greatest gear to help you kick off your ranger career.
Get a hold of the "Newbie Package" by just simply creating a new account and hop 'in on to Combat Arms: the Classic.

1x Newbie Package.
1. Tempest Aviator Package
2. Myst-Gear
3. Myst Envious Tiger
4. Myst Nevada Lobo
5. Myst Abstract Mystery
6. Bloody Myst Crate
7. Supply Crate Myst-NEMEXIS

================================================================================

Event #2: WANT MORE GOODIES? HERE’S MORE!

Event Details
Attention Rangers!
Join us in celebration as we add support for the Arabic Language to Combat Arms: the Classic as well as Combat Arms: the Classic now available on Steam.
Of course, celebrations call for gifts like Christmas but in July. Early right? I see no one complaining. By the way! Gifts are worth over us$150. Yeah!
Hop on to Combat Arms and claim our treats we got in store for you. See you on the battlefield Rangers!
Happy Hunting. Out!

Eligibility: All CAC Players
Requirements: Login to CAC
Duration: July 14, 2020 – August 14, 2020

Reward Details:
Just login during the event and claim a generous haul worth over US$150!
Your eligible to receive the rewards by logging in to the game.

Event Rewards: Items worth US$150

================================================================================

Event #3: RISE UP THE RANKS! LIMITED TIME BOOST


Let’s kick off the summer with some bombastic race to the top and what can be more satisfying than a hefty boost to help you get there. Battle your way to the pedestals of legends and claim your own ultimate glory! For the entire month of July, we are boosting not by 100% not even by 200% but an eye-popping 300% for EXP. Get your pockets stocked up with a 200% GP gain. Swee~eeet!
See you on the battlefield Rangers!
Happy Hunting. Out!

Eligibility: All CAC Players
Requirements: New or Current CAC Accounts
Duration: July 14, 2020 – August 14, 2020

Get 300% EXP and 200% GP gain for an entire month as you battle your way to the highest rank titles!
All Servers will receive increased EXP and GP gain from the 1st of July until the 31st of August.

300% EXP gain
200% GP gain

================================================================================

EVENT 4: DOMINATE THE SURVIVAL PASS (SEASON 1)


Brave the challenges in the Survival Pass and earn great stuff to amp up your game! Enter the perilous trials of the Survival Pass in FREE Access and VIP Access this July.
See you on the battlefield Rangers!
Happy Hunting. Out!

Eligibility: All CAC Players
Requirements: New or Current CAC Accounts

Get FREE access to the Survival Pass and earn some sweet, sweet loots!

notes.title: COMBAT ARMS the: CLASSIC
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/6a88e67ff7d188b36ca23494ce8435481fba5c48.jpg[/img]

[h2]OVERVIEW[/h2]

-	Abilities are categorized into two types: [b]Active[/b] and [b]Passive[/b].

	[b]Active Abilities[/b] have a usage time limit and a cooldown period. They are only active after triggering. They are activated by pressing ~ and the slot they are assigned to.

	[b]Passive Abilities[/b] are always active during gameplay.

-	Players have three ability slots, which can be filled by up to three abilities. Some abilities take more than one slot, however. Equipping them limits the number of abilities a player may bring to battle.


[i][h2][b]ACTIVE ABILITIES[/b][/h2][/i]
[h3][u][b]EAGLE EYE[/b][/u][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/287cf71bed2c68c84bdcf813f0cccf75e2a17e67.png[/img]

-	[b]Information:[/b] Improves accuracy for both you and your teammates. This ability will not apply to any weapons not dependent on accuracy (such as Mines or Claymores).
-	[b]Type:[/b] Active
-	[b]Ability Slot: [/b]2


[h3][u][b]RESOURCEFUL[/b][/u][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/509d18701d86be9f9ea68cc0c9f916f083d39315.png[/img]

-	[b]Information:[/b] When you kill an enemy player, there’s a chance they may leave behind Limited-Ammo, All-Ammo, or Recovery Items! You will have a short time to pick these up, after which they will be free for your team to recover.
-	[b]Type:[/b] Active
-	[b]Ability Slot:[/b] 1


[h3][u][b]SPOILS OF WAR[/b][/u][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/f35119965f55242f9c0b44bb8f8bea5fe7dfcab8.png[/img]

-	[b]Information:[/b] Earn 10 GP for any firearms recovered from fallen soldiers during battle. This ability works up to 10 times per match.
-	[b]Type: [/b]Active
-	[b]Ability Slot:[/b] 2

[h2]SILENT SQUARE[/h2]

[b]Introduction:[/b] An expelled secret agent from JSF organization requested refuge. Creed decided to provide him a refuge because he has all the secret information of JSF who is active all over the world. Creed agent came to contact with him at a small town square. However, JSF agents attacked Creed agent and the square became chaos.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/4f0d6fc4df77bfc5374fc2ffd34086161718322e.jpg[/img]


[b]Description:[/b] The new map is called Silent Square and takes players to a European town that provides an intense (and claustrophobic) new combat experience.

[h2]COSTA RECON[/h2]

[b]Introduction:[/b] The insurgent forces are tipped off that their supply outpost, OP Slaven 152, is in danger, and decide their supplies must be relocated. Unfortunately, the military detects its relocation efforts. Now the insurgents must secure their supplies by either blowing them up or moving them before the imminent military raid.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/071c8c779fa68ec216bbfe4311fe34047c278bd0.jpg[/img]

[b]Description:[/b] The map takes place along a beach outpost. It is having an asymmetrical design. It is about twice the size of Junk Flea and features two large shed-like buildings at either end of the map, two small houses in the middle, and a large amount of boxes/crates in the middle.

notes.title: COMBAT ARMS the: CLASSIC
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/63799b3cd034a0eb8e8dbdd269d835df8f514f79.jpg[/img]


[h2]OIL RIG[/h2]

I[b]ntroduction:[/b] Intelligence acquired by a UAF agent has discovered that a large cache of stolen funds and resources have been hidden by War Corp on a decommissioned Oil Rig. UAF agents are being dispatched to secure the platform and clear out any remaining War Corp personnel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/b525fa12c99c93d64e5b4726b1b2949a36d32441.jpg[/img]

[b]Description:[/b] Originally drafted by in-game player FractalShot on the 2010's Map Design Contest, Oil Rig is the 31st map to be released in Combat Arms, and one of the first maps to be remastered. Oil Rig is a large map consisting of, as its name suggests, an oil rig in the middle of an ocean. In team game modes, spawns are located at each end of the map: the 'pump' station and living quarters. Stairs and ladders are present in and around each respective spawns allowing players to access the rooftops and crane.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37914780/142245904e7693bc02e4c8570187cf0f088e7d87.jpg[/img]
